summary: Iterate: Polish the same Taskboard agent-progress UI after user feedback. In Changed files, make it unmistakable that the expanded content is a real unified diff: show per-file additions and deletions computed from the server-returned patch, select a file and render added/removed code through the existing native Diff component, with clear loading/empty/stale/unavailable states and no fabricated counts. For blocked Build states like the supplied screenshot, replace or supplement the ambiguous icon/buried instruction with a clear accessible 'Continue in thread' action near the blocker summary that opens the existing Build thread without pinning Taskboard or dispatching duplicate work. Preserve all existing guards and non-sticky navigation.

state.request: Fix the Taskboard automatic-start behavior that pauses work when a build reports recoverable blockers like the supplied Roten-App result. Improve automatic work startup so blocker summaries are handled accurately and the task does not stop prematurely when actionable implementation work can continue, while preserving genuine human-decision, tracker, evidence, and policy gates.
